data: Obsidian destinations, result sources and CSV
See where a send landed, trace a pinned result, and drag sheets and selections out of Scratch.

See where your Obsidian send landed. The Notes pane shows the vault and delivery mode. After a confirmed send, use Open to go to the note. Editable sync shows conflicting values side by side so you can pick what to keep. Notes and Obsidian guide.

Trace a pinned result. Expand the floating card to see its formula and inputs. Jump straight to a cell, range or screenshot source from the card. Formula guide.

Drag out a sheet or save a CSV. Drag the sheet name beyond the panel to open a larger live view. Control-drag a selection or sheet name to share a table or drop a CSV in Finder. You can also export CSV from the command palette. Grid guide.
